answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Each attempt carries a deposit of 49 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. Every entry must show Commissioned tub maker market writ before the ledger opens, because a writ makers file after stave reviews. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. One grove, one entry. The clerk notes hollow. Every ivory is counted once.
